release_notes: MBT POS v3.1.7 shows a cashier void request on the till and the web dashboard as Pending void, including who asked and why. A voided receipt stays on the dashboard and is marked Voided. Approving the request with the Super-Admin PIN voids that receipt. Also carries the v3.1.6 M-Pesa save, Mixed-only split pay, and delivery cost tracking. Preserves AppData identity, license state and mbt_pos.db.
